text: This is Webcamo. Plug your phone in with a cable, and it becomes a high-quality webcam, on Linux, Mac and Windows.
style: warm, confident intro, natural brisk conversational pace, no long pauses

text: Laptop cameras usually look washed out and noisy, and Wi-Fi webcam apps freeze and drop out in the middle of a meeting.
style: relatable, a little tired, natural brisk conversational pace, no long pauses

text: Yet the phone in your pocket has a far better camera than any laptop.
style: light, a bit playful, natural brisk conversational pace, no long pauses

text: The idea is simple. The phone runs a small server and encodes the video in hardware, and the computer pulls the stream over the USB cable. No internet, no account, no cloud.
style: clear, explaining, natural brisk conversational pace, no long pauses

text: On the computer, Webcamo turns that stream into a virtual camera, so any app, Zoom, Meet or OBS, sees it as a normal webcam.
style: clear, confident, natural brisk conversational pace, no long pauses

text: Installing is easy: a Setup file for Windows, a DMG for Mac, and a DEB or AppImage for Linux. And on the phone, the Webcamo app for Android and iPhone.
style: practical, upbeat, natural brisk conversational pace, no long pauses

text: Open Webcamo on your computer and plug in your phone. It finds the phone by itself, opens the connection, and starts the stream.
style: guiding, calm, natural brisk conversational pace, no long pauses

text: From the dashboard you control everything: resolution, frame rate, lens, zoom and lighting. You change them while you're live, and your camera never disappears for the people in the call.
style: confident, showing off a little, natural brisk conversational pace, no long pauses

text: If the cable gets pulled, or the phone gets hot, Webcamo recovers by itself. It lowers the quality until the phone cools down, then brings it back.
style: reassuring, steady, natural brisk conversational pace, no long pauses

text: And in your meeting, you just pick Webcamo from the camera list. That's it.
style: light, satisfied, natural brisk conversational pace, no long pauses

text: Webcamo. Your phone is now your webcam. Download it from this page.
style: warm, upbeat outro, natural brisk conversational pace, no long pauses
